desc: A Persian-speaking man around 30, natural standard Tehrani accent. Warm, slightly husky, gently low voice, never artificially deep. He narrates a true survival story in second person like someone telling it to one listener by a campfire late at night: close, calm, confident and quietly tense. Tension comes from calm control, never from shouting. Realistic breathing and human rhythm. Avoid news-anchor delivery, theatrical acting, movie-trailer intensity, whispering and exaggerated bass.
text: روز دهم. زمین زیر تنت می‌لرزه. خاک از سقف تونل می‌ریزه روی صورتت. بیرون، آسمون رنگ آتیشه. و دم ورودی، یه چیز خیلی بزرگ داره نفس می‌کشه.
